Name: Museum Basement
Author: Alkogen
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Adds a basement to the museum because I made the map on a whim and figured I'd at least make a mod out of it. Pretty cool if you have mods that add more artifacts without adding museum space, or if you are me and you like a little more flavor in your funny farming game. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is likely NOT compatible, however I haven't tested it. This is mostly because chances are that mod loads after this one, but feel free to try it out yourself. I'll try to fix this in the near future.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url] is specially compatible from this mod. The "VMV: Lower" option is the most compatible with most mods.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url]'s museum is NOT compatible by default. You can disable Cape Stardew's museum edit, or use non-default settings for this mod.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38335]Mycology Mineralogy Marine Biology and More of Teyvat[/url] is likely not compatible when the basement is under the library.[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with recolors since this uses vanilla tilesets ONLY.[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with all mods that do not edit the museum, this only edits the map, there's no schedule changes packed with this mod.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[size=3]Museum Basement is very configurable mostly because I like making silly map edits and I like to practice with making them. I plan to make a compatibility guide for all the configs sometime in the future.[/size]
[list]
[*]Basement Size: Which size of the basement that should be used. Currently only has Default and Small settings.[/*]
[*]Basement Location: Whether to put the basement under the Library or under the Artifact area.[/*]
[*]Compatibility Mode: Overrides the other two configs and has special compatibility with other mods. Patches with this config will not work if the corresponding mod isn't currently in use. Only has compatibility with Visit Mount Vapius for now.[/*]
[/list]
